title: Apexspace customer strip
description: A charcoal band with one plain line of text and, under it, an edge-to-edge strip of square black tiles split by thin seams, each holding a customer name. Seven tiles fill the row on desktop; on phones the strip drifts slowly to the left in a seamless loop.
notes: names are text, each in one of three styles (sans, display, mono); swap in logo images through the same tiles if you have them
the loop runs below 1024px only (CSS); with reduced motion the strip scrolls by hand instead
seven names fill the desktop row; fewer leave wider tiles
